title: A median minimizes the L¹ deviation on F (Simon 5.1, (31)–(32))
statement: Let α be a type with a σ-algebra and μ a measure on it. Let F ⊆ α be measurable with μ(F) = ofReal a for a real number a > 0, let u : α → ℝ be measurable and integrable on F, and let c₀ ∈ ℝ satisfy ofReal(a/2) ≤ μ(F ∩ {x : u(x) ≤ c₀}) and ofReal(a/2) ≤ μ(F ∩ {x : c₀ ≤ u(x)}). Then for every c ∈ ℝ, ∫⁻_F ofReal|u − c₀| dμ ≤ ∫⁻_F ofReal|u − c| dμ.
lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (F : Set α) (a c₀ : ℝ) (u : α → ℝ), MeasurableSet F → 0 < a → μ F = ENNReal.ofReal a → Measurable u → IntegrableOn u F μ → ENNReal.ofReal (a / 2) ≤ μ (F ∩ {x | u x ≤ c₀}) → ENNReal.ofReal (a / 2) ≤ μ (F ∩ {x | c₀ ≤ u x}) → ∀ c : ℝ, ∫⁻ x in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - c₀| ∂μ ≤ ∫⁻ x in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - c| ∂μ
